profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Insight Global
profile.summary:
Front-end engineer with 6+ years of experience building scalable, user-centric web applications using Angular, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript frameworks. I’ve led the development of high-impact features—including contributions to patent-pending technologies—and played a key role in platform growth through multiple stages, including acquisition readiness.

Self-taught, bilingual (English/Spanish), and known for blending technical expertise with a strong background in team and operations management. Passionate about clean code, intuitive UX, and agile collaboration. Recognized for consistently high velocity, team mentorship, and delivering innovative solutions in fast-paced environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
As part of Axon, I contribute to the continued evolution of the Fusus platform, delivering scalable front-end solutions, improving performance, and ensuring seamless integration with Axon’s broader ecosystem. I mentor junior engineers, foster cross-team collaboration, and help maintain a high-performing, growth-oriented engineering culture.

Technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, Python, Django, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
At Fusus, I played a pivotal role in driving high-impact feature initiatives including AI-powered detections, real-time video workflows, records management and third-party integrations, etc. I contributed to patent-pending technologies and helped position the platform for scalability, performance, and acquisition-readiness. Recognized for consistently meeting sprint goals, managing critical releases, and mentoring early-career engineers. My work also extended to backend services, making me a full-spectrum contributor to the product’s technical success and business growth—culminating in Fusus’s successful acquisition by Axon.

Technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, Python, Django, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Joined the Fusus engineering team as a front-end intern, where I quickly ramped up on core product architecture and contributed directly to production-level features. Maintained consistently high sprint velocity, demonstrating a strong grasp of development workflows and agile practices. My performance and ability to deliver value in a fast-paced environment earned the trust of engineering leadership and led to a full-time offer. This experience laid the foundation for my continued growth and long-term impact at Fusus.

Technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, React, Python, Django, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Assistant General Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed budget and monitored inventory, health and safety regulations, and quality of food 
        production.
•	Supervised daily restaurant operations and assisted back and front of house staff.
•	Safely handled all monetary transactions including making deposits/drops and preparing necessary paperwork for company records.
•	Handled all hiring and training of new staff in providing excellent customer service, speedy order taking, food/beverage delivery, and creating a positive atmosphere for guests.
•	Responsible for writing and reviewing store sales forecast and P&L statements.

positions.title: Shift Lead
positions.description:
•	Monitored team members to ensure all operating procedures were followed to provide a world-class guest experience resulting in repeat business and revenue increase.
•	Entrusted with responsibility to record accurate daily cash records and forecasted sales, and deliver bank deposits.

positions.title: Cook/Prep
positions.description:
•	Followed menu and recipes to prepare and/or cook catering, lunch and dinner items in a timely manner to stay on schedule.
•	Maintained a clean and sanitary kitchen ensuring it met state guidelines for food safety and inspections.
•	Prepped and prepared at various cook stations based on class rotation.

positions.title: Host/Cashier
positions.description: Provided fast friendly guest services including but not limited to; Recording orders through POS and accurate cash currency handling.

positions.title: Legal Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
•	Executed front and back office administrative duties including but not limited to; processing incoming and outgoing mail assortment, reception coverage and inventory/supplies management.
•	Composed and revised legal documents for attorneys, including letters, dispositions, and court filings.
•	Enhanced client relationships in person and by phone with sensitivity and confidentiality.
•	Researched public records and prepared discovery requests and responses.

positions.title: Inventory Specialist
positions.description:
•	Managed a HUB store and was responsible for identifying as well as keeping inventory of incoming and outgoing automotive parts to commercial clientele and partnering stores. 
•	Resolved inventory discrepancies, problem orders and inter-company transfer issues.
•	Solved customers service issues and complaints at the store and through the phone.
